title: CWP/16815/2025 of SANTOSH RANI AND ANOTHERS Vs STATE OF HARYANA AND ORS
text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB AND HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH 152 CWP-16815-2025 DATE OF DECISION: 28.07.2025 SANTOSH RANI AND ANOTHER … Petitioner (s) Versus STATE OF HARYANA AND OTHERS ... Respondent(s) CORAM: HON’BLE MR. JUSTICE ANUPINDER SINGH GREWAL HON’BLE MR. JUSTICE DEEPAK MANCHANDA Present: Mr. Ivneet Singh Pabla, Advocate for the petitioners. ANUPINDER SINGH GREWAL, J. (ORAL) The petitioners are seeking a direction to the respondents to allot a residential plot/commercial plot in a well-developed area in terms of the Policy dated 09.11.2010 (Annexure P-1).

2. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that although the land of the petitioners had been acquired by the Kurukshetra Development Board but the respondents are not considering the claim of the petitioners for allotment of a residential plot/commercial plot in a well-developed area in terms of the Policy for Rehabilitation and Resettlement of Oustees dated 09.11.2010 (Annexure P1). He also submits that the petitioners have sent a representation in this regard on 21.05.2025 (Annexure P-3) to the respondents but no action has been taken so far.

3. Issue notice to the respondents.

4. At the asking of the Court, Mr. Deepak Bhardwaj, Addl. AG, Haryana accepts notice on behalf of the respondents.

5. Heard.

6. In view of the above, the petition is disposed of with a direction to respondent No.1 to consider and decide the representation of the petitioners dated 21.05.2025 (Annexure P-3) in accordance with law within a period of four months from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order. (ANUPINDER SINGH GREWAL) JUDGE (DEEPAK MANCHANDA) JUDGE 28.07.2025 SwarnjitS
